hero.description: A unique digital artwork, assisted by artificial intelligence and inspired by African cosmogonies. Composed for you, or for someone you choose to honor.

gesture.body1: Sixty thousand years ago, your ancestors left Africa. Some stayed. They were born under other skies, spoke other languages, and carved other masks.

items.title: An artwork, not a test
items.body: TOTEM ANCESTRAL is not a personality quiz. It is a narrative, visual and sonic composition, shaped by what you entrust to the griot.

items.title: Secrecy, not exposure

items.title: Transmission, not decoration
items.body: The box is made to be kept, offered, reread and passed on. An intimate digital object, not a passing image.

house.subtitle: About Totem Ancestral, now at the heart of the homepage.
paragraphs: TOTEM ANCESTRAL is an artistic creation house founded in Paris.
We compose unique digital artworks, personal fables inspired by African cosmogonies and assisted by artificial intelligence.
We do not do science, genealogy or divination. We make artworks. To celebrate someone close. To offer oneself an inner journey. To nourish imagination.
Each artwork carries a number, a signature and a certificate. It will never be reproduced, reissued or resold. It is your edition in the current collection.

pillars.title: What we believe
pillars.text: Every human being deserves a story that resembles them. Not a cold truth, but a fable held with care.

pillars.title: What we refuse
pillars.text: We do not make folklore, identity certainty or mystical promises. We treat imagination as an art.

pillars.title: Our standard
pillars.text: Rarity, precision, confidentiality, durable files and clear delivery guide every box.

house.quote: “An artwork is never finished. It is only entrusted to the one who receives it.”

items.q: I expected a personality test. I received an artwork. I read the parchment three times. I listened to the voice alone, at night. Something settled.
I offered it to my mother for her birthday. She cried. Not from sadness, from something deeper.
I'm not African. I was curious. The parchment is a small literary work. I framed the image; it hangs above my desk.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions.
faq.subtitle: The essential answers before entrusting your material to the griot.

items.q: Is this a DNA or genealogy test?
items.a: No. Totem Ancestral is a personalized artistic fiction. It draws from your answers and an African imaginary without claiming to reveal a real origin.
Yes. Each box is composed for one person, with its number, certificate and files. The house does not resell your edition to another client.

items.q: Does artificial intelligence replace the artist?
items.a: No. It is a composition tool. Artistic direction, narrative frame, tone and box constraints belong to the house.

items.q: How long does the passage take?
items.a: The questionnaire takes about fifteen minutes. The target box delivery is fifteen minutes after confirmed payment, thirty minutes for Totem Family.
Depending on the offer: PDF parchment, high-resolution PNG artwork, MP3 voice of the imaginary ancestor and numbered certificate of authenticity.
Yes. The box can be ordered as a gift. A free gift card is planned and you can prepare the experience for a recipient.

instructions.title: Before crossing
instructions.subtitle: Prepare your mind and your space to receive the words of the elders.

items.title: Set the world down
items.text: Sit as if before a fire at night, when the elders speak. Let the noise outside fall away before you begin.

items.title: Open your ears
items.text: The ancestor has crossed sixty thousand years to speak to you. Turn up the volume, breathe, then listen to what arrives.

items.title: Speak true
items.text: The griot does not want the right answer. He wants yours, the one that comes from farther than memory.

items.title: Keep your TOTEM
items.text: As you keep a name, as you keep a secret. It exists only through you, and will live nowhere else.

une_liberte_une_originalite_quelqu_un_qu: A sense of freedom. A unique spirit. Someone you can't really pigeonhole.
une_phrase_qu_on_te_dit_souvent_que_tu_a: A phrase you hear all the time, whether you like hearing it or not...
une_sagesse_un_regard_different_quelqu_u: Wisdom. A different perspective. Someone who says the things others don't dare to say.
une_uvre_numerique_unique_assistee_par_i: A unique digital work, created with the help of artificial intelligence, inspired by African cosmogonies.

vos_reponses_sont_utilisees_uniquement_p: Your responses are used solely to create your work and are then securely archived. Fully GDPR-compliant.

intro.title: The Griot speaks to you.
intro.body1: There are no right or wrong answers here. There is your truth, and the truth you allow yourself to see.
intro.body2: Answer with what you feel. Not with what you think you should say.
intro.body3: Time does not exist here. The ancestor is waiting.

questionUi.freedom: You chose freedom. The griot wants to understand yours, in one sentence.
questionUi.audioHint: The question plays automatically, tap to replay.
questionUi.wordsExceeded: Keep it under {max} words so the griot can take it all in.

lines: He now holds your truth in his hands.

waiting.title: The artwork is being composed.

The portrait comes alive in the shadows...
A little patience, the ancestors do not rush.
waiting.body: You can close this window. The ancestors are finishing their work.

questions.griot: Close your eyes for a moment. Think of nature, of what attracts you without being able to explain it.
questions.question: Which natural element calls you most deeply?

choices.text: Fire dancing in the night, I am drawn to its light, its unpredictable warmth, its way of transforming everything.
Water that never stops flowing, river, ocean, rain, I always return to it.
Earth beneath my feet, roots, stones, dense forests, what lasts and holds.
Wind that carries everything away, open space, heights, the horizon no one can catch.

field.label: Anything else?
field.placeholder: An element, a landscape, a sensation that is not on the list...

questions.question: When do you feel most alive?

choices.text: When I protect someone, when I fight for what is right, when I am at the heart of the action.
When I create something, an idea, an artwork, a project, when my hands give life to my vision.
When I am surrounded by those I love, in laughter, sharing and connection.
When I am alone in nature or in silence, when I observe, understand and see far.

field.label: + add nuance
field.placeholder: Describe the moment when you feel fully alive...

questions.griot: Listen carefully. What others see in you, without you asking, is often what you refuse to see in yourself.
questions.question: What do others see in you, without you asking?

choices.text: Strength. Presence. Someone people turn to when things go wrong, or when a decision must be made.
Wisdom. A different gaze. Someone who says what others do not dare formulate.
Gentleness. Warmth. Someone who welcomes, listens and makes people better.
Freedom. Originality. Someone no one can really put into a box.

field.label: The griot has listened. If you want to whisper a nuance, he will hear it.
field.placeholder: A sentence people often say to you, whether you like hearing it or not...

questions.griot: Trials reveal. Not what we say we would do, what we actually do.
questions.question: Facing a trial, how do you truly react?

choices.text: I move forward. I act. I would rather make a mistake in action than remain still in doubt.
I step back, observe and analyze, then choose the right moment and place to strike precisely.
I look for others, I build alliances and create support around me.
I go inward, I search for the answer in silence before looking outside.

field.label: + add nuance
field.placeholder: How do you really handle difficult situations...

questions.griot: There is an hour in the day when everything feels clearer. An hour when you are truly yourself.
questions.question: At what time does your soul truly awaken?

choices.text: At dawn, when the world is still silent and everything is possible, before the others arrive.
In full daylight, in action, movement, encounters and living noise.
At dusk, when light changes, boundaries blur and reflection becomes possible.
At night, when the world sleeps and I am finally alone with my deepest thoughts.

field.label: Your own hour?
field.placeholder: The time of day when you feel truly yourself...

questions.griot: This is the only question you may choose not to answer. But if you do answer it, the ancestors will stand closer.
questions.question: Where do your ancestors come from, as far back as you know?

choices.text: West Africa: Senegal, Mali, Guinea, Ivory Coast, Nigeria, Ghana, Benin and thereabouts.
Central, East or Southern Africa: Congo, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, South Africa and thereabouts.
Caribbean, the Americas or the African diaspora: an African origin, likely but undetermined.
Europe, Asia, Oceania or anywhere else: I am here to uncover my deep African roots.

field.label: Do you know something precise?
field.placeholder: A country, an ethnic group, a region you know or want to explore...

questions.griot: Anger is sacred. It says what truly matters. What angers you reveals what you care about most.
questions.question: What sets fire inside you, your deepest anger?

choices.text: Injustice. Seeing the weak crushed by the powerful. Seeing truth mocked. Seeing rights trampled.
Accepted mediocrity. People settling for little. Wasted potential. Abandoned dreams.
Betrayal and lies. Hypocrisy. People playing a role instead of being true.
Destruction, of nature, beauty, memory, and what took centuries to build.

field.label: The ancestors hear those who dare to name what they usually keep inside.
field.placeholder: What truly gets you out of yourself, what you fight inwardly...

questions.griot: Imagine that in a hundred years, someone speaks of you. What do they say?
questions.question: What trace do you want to leave in the world?

choices.text: I protected. I defended. I made the world fairer for those who come after me.
I created. I built something that will last, an artwork, a company, an idea, a legacy.
I connected. I brought people together. I created bonds where there were none.
I revealed. I spoke truths no one dared to say. I opened eyes.

field.label: + add nuance
field.placeholder: What you want people to remember from your life, in a few words...

questions.griot: Dreams speak. Not literally, symbolically. What returns in your inner world?
questions.question: Your inner symbol, what returns in your dreams or your life?

choices.text: Water, a river, an ocean, a rain, something that flows, carries away and purifies.
Height, a cliff, a summit, a flight, a view from above, a perspective others do not have.
Fire or light, a flame, a sun, lightning, something that burns and illuminates.
Roots or forest, trees, earth, ancient paths, something deep and durable.

field.label: Your own symbol?
field.placeholder: An image, recurring dream or symbol that often returns in your life...

questions.griot: Final question. The most important. The ancestor watches you. He sees your whole life. Not what you have done, what you carry.
questions.question: If an ancestor could look at your life, what would he see?

choices.text: A warrior who has not yet found the true battle. An immense strength waiting for the right moment.
A sage who speaks too little. A deep wisdom the world needs to hear more often.
A heart that loves too strongly and not enough itself. A generosity that sometimes forgets itself.
A free spirit in a body trying to fit into boxes. A soul too large for the limits imposed on it.

field.label: Tell him now what you have never said out loud.
field.placeholder: A confession, a truth, a word, something you have never said out loud...
